<thought>We need the number of unique hydrogen environments for a compound, but no SMILES is provided. The only tool that can give us that information is `proton_nmr_spectra`, which requires a SMILES string. Since we have no SMILES, we cannot perform the measurement. Therefore we cannot determine the answer.</thought>
<final_answer>Insufficient information: SMILES string of the compound is required to determine the number of unique hydrogen environments.</final_answer>
